title: Network Architect - Platform Infrastructure-DC Connect
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior Network Product Manager**
Global Network Services | Platform Infrastructure
  
  
**Role Summary:**
Own the global network product portfolio across data centers and datarooms , route/switch, observability, automation, lifecycle, resiliency, and vendor governance.
  
  
**Function**
Platform Infrastructure / DC connect
  
  
**Level**
Senior Product Manager
  
  
**Primary Scope**
Cisco, Arista, LAN/WAN, VXLAN, L2/L3 networking, monitoring, automation, lifecycle management
  
  
**Key Outcomes**
Resilient network services, product roadmap execution, vendor accountability, reduced technical debt, improved observability
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
At EY, network services are foundational to secure, resilient, and high-performing technology operations. As the firm modernizes infrastructure, strengthens cyber resilience, expands cloud connectivity, and improves global platform reliability, EY requires a senior product leader to provide end-to-end ownership of the global datacenter dataroom network product portfolio.
  
  
The Senior Network Product Manager will own network strategy, roadmap, lifecycle, standards, observability, service health, and vendor governance. This role requires deep technical credibility across Cisco and Arista route/switch platforms, VXLAN, L2/L3 networking, WAN, routing protocols, and network management tools, combined with practical product leadership and executive communication skills.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Product Strategy and Ownership
  
  

* Own the global Network Product strategy, roadmap, standards, and lifecycle management.
* Define multi-year modernization plans for network resiliency, security, automation, supportability, and simplification.
* Align network capabilities with business priorities, cloud strategy, regulatory obligations, cyber requirements, and operational needs.
* Define product KPIs, OKRs, service levels, technical debt plans, capacity trends, and platform health metrics.
* Partner with engineering, operations, security, procurement, and finance teams to support roadmap execution and investment planning.

Technical Product Leadership
  
  

* Act as the senior product owner and technical authority for enterprise route/switch networking across data centers, data rooms, campus, WAN, and cloud connectivity.
* Provide product direction for Cisco Catalyst 9000, Cisco Nexus, Arista switching, routers, load balancer connectivity, DCI, and network segmentation patterns.
* Guide architecture standards for VXLAN EVPN fabrics, L2/L3 designs, routing domains, high availability, resiliency, and failover patterns.
* Ensure network standards account for OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, route redistribution, multicast, QoS, network segmentation, and secure connectivity requirements.
* Review product risks, design gaps, lifecycle exposure, and operational friction points across the global network estate.

Network Observability and Intelligence
  
  

* Own product strategy for syslog, telemetry, packet visibility, network performance monitoring, configuration compliance, and network maps.
* Improve visibility into device health, topology, routing state, capacity, configuration drift, fault domains, and service impact.
* Drive adoption of proactive monitoring, event correlation, root cause analysis, and automated runbook capabilities.
* Establish network health dashboards used by operations, engineering, security, and leadership teams.

Lifecycle, Risk, and Compliance
  
  

* Maintain product lifecycle plans for hardware, software, firmware, support contracts, end-of-life, end-of-support, and vulnerability exposure.
* Partner with cyber, risk, and operations teams to prioritize patching, remediation, modernization, and compensating controls.
* Ensure audit-ready documentation, ownership clarity, design traceability, and standard evidence for critical network products.
* Drive technical debt reduction and simplify non-standard designs, legacy connectivity, and unsupported platforms.

Vendor and Partner Governance
  
  

* Govern network delivery from strategic partners, managed service providers, telecom carriers, Cisco, Arista, and network tooling vendors.
* Review vendor designs, operational changes, implementation plans, support performance, and service quality against product standards.
* Hold partners accountable for resiliency, documentation, standards compliance, operational readiness, and measurable outcomes.
* Influence sourcing, contract renewals, support models, licensing, and platform investment decisions.

Automation and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Champion network automation, configuration standardization, and infrastructure-as-code practices.
* Drive use of APIs, Ansible, Git-based network configuration, telemetry, and orchestration to reduce manual effort and improve control.
* Promote repeatable deployment models, self-service capabilities, automated compliance checks, and self-healing operations where practical.

Core Technical Expertise
  
  
**Domain**
**Expected Knowledge**
**Cisco Platforms**
Cisco Catalyst 9000, Cisco Nexus, IOS-XE, NX-OS, route/switch, HA patterns, software lifecycle, Smart Licensing, TAC engagement
  
  
**Arista Platforms**
Arista data center and campus switching, EOS, CloudVision concepts, route/switch operations, lifecycle and support models
  
  
**Network Architecture**
L2/L3 enterprise networking, data center fabrics, VXLAN EVPN, DCI, LAN, campus, WAN, SD-WAN, cloud connectivity
  
  
**Routing and Switching**
OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, route redistribution, STP, VLANs, VRFs, multicast, QoS, HSRP/VRRP, ECMP, segmentation
  
  
**Observability and Tools**
NetBrain, SNMP, syslog, telemetry, packet capture, ThousandEyes, SolarWinds, LogicMonitor, Elastic.
  
  
**Automation and Governance**
Ansible, APIs, templates, configuration compliance, drift monitoring, Git-based workflows, policy-based controls, runbook automation
  
  
**Risk and Lifecycle**
EOL/EOS, vulnerability remediation, firmware/software upgrades, capacity planning, resiliency testing, audit evidence, documentation standards
  
  
**Skills And Experience**

* 14+ years of progressive enterprise networking experience in large, global, highly regulated environments.
* 5+ years of product ownership, platform ownership, architecture leadership, or senior network engineering leadership experience.
* Proven experience managing network product roadmaps, lifecycle plans, budgets, vendor governance, and operational performance.
* Deep hands-on understanding of Cisco and Arista route/switch technologies with ability to challenge designs and guide standards.
* Strong understanding of LAN, WAN, data center, cloud connectivity, routing protocols, network segmentation, and resiliency engineering.
* Experience building product health dashboards, service metrics, technical debt plans, and leadership-facing executive updates.
* Ability to communicate clearly with executives, technical teams, security stakeholders, procurement, finance, and vendor partners.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure, CCNP Enterprise, Arista ACE, cloud networking, or equivalent practical expertise.
* Experience with network automation, telemetry, NPM/NCM tooling, and configuration compliance platforms.
* Experience operating global network services across multiple data centers, regions, business-critical sites, and cloud providers.
* ITIL, product management, Agile, or service ownership experience.
* Experience modernizing legacy network estates and reducing vendor dependency through standards, automation, and better documentation.

Success Measures
  
  

* Clear product roadmap with measurable delivery milestones and funding alignment.
* Reduced lifecycle risk across network hardware, software, firmware, and support contracts.
* Improved network availability, observability, configuration compliance, and incident response quality.
* Standardized designs and documentation across global data center, data room, WAN, and cloud connectivity services.
* Measurable reduction in technical debt, non-standard patterns, vendor ambiguity, and operational handoff gaps.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Oracle - SCM and Procurement - SCM-Functional Consultant - Senior
description:
**Job Summary:**
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Cloud Supply Chain Management (SCM) and Procurement (PROC) Functional Consultant at Senior level with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience. The successful candidate will independently support and deliver Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation, transformation, rollout and support engagements across Procurement and related SCM areas, including Self Service Procurement, Purchasing, Sourcing, Supplier Qualification and Management, Procurement Contracts, Inventory Management, Order Management, Product Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain Planning, Cost Management, Maintenance and Logistics. The role requires strong hands-on functional capability, client-facing delivery experience and relevant industry/domain expertise to translate real-world source-to-pay and supply-chain requirements into scalable Oracle Fusion solutions. Knowledge of Oracle Redwood user experience and Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio is also expected.
  
**Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**
•Deliver Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM and Procurement implementation, transformation, rollout and support activities from requirements gathering through design, configuration, testing, deployment and stabilization.
  
•Manage assigned workstream tasks, plans, risks, issues, dependencies, quality and stakeholder updates under the guidance of the project lead or manager.
  
•Facilitate business workshops, assess current-state industry processes and translate requirements into scalable future-state Oracle Fusion SCM and Procurement solutions aligned with leading practices.
  
•Perform functional fit-gap analysis, configuration, prototyping, conference room pilots, testing, training, cutover and go-live support.
  
•Design integrated source-to-pay, procure-to-pay and supply-chain solutions across Procurement, Inventory Management, Order Management, Cost Management and related SCM modules, coordinating dependencies with Payables, Finance, Projects, reporting, integration, security and data teams.
  
•Prepare high-quality functional designs, configuration workbooks, process flows, test artefacts, user guides and training materials in line with Oracle implementation methodologies.
  
•Assess Oracle Redwood readiness, support business-process redesign for Redwood pages and guided experiences, and execute adoption, testing and change-impact activities.
  
•Identify suitable SCM use cases for Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio and support the definition of agent topics, instructions, tools, data access, human-approval checkpoints and expected outcomes.
  
•Collaborate with technical, security and integration teams to configure, test, publish and monitor AI agents and agentic workflows within Oracle Fusion.
  
•Follow responsible AI controls covering role-based access, data privacy, traceability, testing, monitoring and business-owner approval.
  
•Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, cutover and production support, and drive timely resolution of defects and functional queries.
  
•Contribute to client presentations, solution demonstrations, estimates, proposals, knowledge assets and practice-development initiatives.
  
•Guide junior consultants, review assigned deliverables and maintain delivery quality and internal KPIs.
  
  
  
Requirements
  
  
**Experience:**
•Minimum 5 years of relevant Oracle SCM and Procurement experience, including strong hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud.
  
•At least two end-to-end ERP implementation or transformation engagements, including at least one Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM implementation.
  
•Strong functional expertise in Oracle Fusion Procurement—including Self Service Procurement, Purchasing, Sourcing, Supplier Qualification and Management, Supplier Portal and Procurement Contracts—together with hands-on knowledge of at least one core SCM area such as Inventory Management, Order Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain Planning, Product Management, Cost Management, Maintenance or Logistics.
  
•Hands-on experience with source-to-pay and procure-to-pay process design, enterprise structures, procurement business units, requisitioning, purchasing, approvals, catalogs, supplier onboarding, sourcing, contracts, receiving, integrations, data migration, reporting and operational controls.
  
•Practical knowledge of Oracle Redwood UX, including Redwood page adoption, process redesign, extension considerations, testing and end-user change management.
  
•Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio, including agent configuration concepts, topics, instructions, tools, workflow orchestration, deployment, security and monitoring.
  
•Ability to support high-value agentic SCM use cases, such as supplier onboarding assistance, procurement policy guidance, order exception management, inventory insights or planning support.
  
•Client-facing delivery experience with sound planning, estimation, risk management, testing and quality assurance capabilities.
  
•Demonstrable industry/domain experience in at least one sector—such as retail, government, energy, real estate, oil and gas, manufacturing, utilities, logistics or consumer products—with practical understanding of sector-specific procurement, supplier, inventory, fulfilment, planning and operational-control requirements.
  
**Competencies / Skills:**
•Strong stakeholder management, consulting, collaboration and junior-team mentoring skills.
  
•Ability to independently manage assigned functional workstreams, priorities and deliverables within agreed timelines.
  
•Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills, with the ability to explain business and functional concepts clearly.
  
•Strong analytical, industry-process design, problem-solving and decision-making capabilities, with the ability to apply domain knowledge to Oracle Fusion SCM and Procurement solutions.
  
•Sound understanding of responsible AI, data privacy, access controls, human oversight and governance for enterprise agentic solutions.
  
•Awareness of Oracle quarterly updates and the ability to assess new SCM, Redwood and embedded-AI capabilities for business adoption.
  
•Proficiency in delivery and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Azure DevOps or equivalent.
  
•Valid passport and willingness to travel to client sites and work MENA business schedules, including Sunday to Thursday, where required.
  
**Education:**
•Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, Information Systems or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.
  
•Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM and/or Procurement certification in relevant modules is preferred; credentials or demonstrated training in Oracle Redwood and Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio are an added advantage.

title: MS - FDL - Senior Manager - AI Architect
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Senior Manager – AI Architect**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager – AI Architect to lead the strategy, architecture, and governance of enterprise AI solutions supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines AI/ML architecture, technical leadership, and people management, translating business needs into secure, scalable, and responsible AI solutions. The ideal candidate will integrate predictive machine learning, generative AI, and appropriately controlled agentic workflows with enterprise applications and data to enable transformation across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will own AI architecture quality and technology roadmaps across engagements, lead architects and technical specialists, and partner with data science, engineering, product, security, risk, and business teams to guide solutions from discovery through production adoption and measurable value realization.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**AI Strategy & Architecture Leadership**

* Define the AI architecture strategy and roadmap, aligning prioritized use cases with enterprise technology standards, data readiness, risk appetite, and business objectives.
* Lead discovery and feasibility assessments; determine when rules, analytics, traditional ML, or generative AI are appropriate, and validate options through measurable proofs of concept.
* Design end-to-end AI architectures spanning data ingestion, feature or embedding pipelines, model training or adaptation, retrieval, inference, orchestration, APIs, and enterprise integration.
* Evaluate model providers, open-weight models, cloud AI services, and build-versus-buy options; balance quality, latency, scalability, cost, licensing, data residency, and vendor dependency.
* Establish reference architectures and design standards for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), model serving, and agentic workflows, including permission-aware retrieval, tool authorization, and human approval for consequential actions.
* Lead architecture reviews and resolve complex AI design challenges; guide model selection, prompting, fine-tuning where justified, evaluation design, and integration with production systems.

**AI Delivery, Governance & Operational Excellence**

* Provide architecture oversight across AI initiatives, defining acceptance criteria, technical dependencies, delivery risks, and stage gates from experimentation through production readiness.
* Partner with engineering and platform teams to establish MLOps and LLMOps practices, including versioned datasets, models and prompts, reproducible evaluation, deployment controls, and rollback.
* Define task-specific evaluation frameworks covering predictive performance, groundedness, retrieval quality, hallucination risk, robustness, fairness where relevant, latency, and cost; validate against representative test data and business baselines.
* Design production monitoring for data and model drift, output quality, reliability, usage, and inference spend; establish fallback behavior, incident response, and controlled model or provider updates.
* Embed responsible AI, privacy, security, and applicable compliance controls with risk and legal teams, including data provenance, audit trails, prompt-injection defenses, sensitive-data protection, and risk-based human oversight.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Lead and scale an AI architecture team, coordinating data scientists, ML engineers, data engineers, and application specialists across engagements; develop architects and technical leads.
* Build an inclusive, high-performance AI practice focused on rigorous experimentation, responsible innovation, reusable knowledge, and measurable business outcomes.
* Own hiring, resource planning, performance management, succession planning, and capability development aligned with AI delivery demand and evolving technology needs.
* Mentor architects and technical specialists on AI design, evaluation rigor, production readiness, stakeholder influence, and career growth; strengthen peer reviews and communities of practice.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with finance transformation leaders, product owners, and clients to identify AI opportunities, clarify process constraints, and define measurable success criteria.
* Present AI solution options, limitations, investment needs, and risk trade-offs to decision-makers; align expectations on automation boundaries, human review, and business value.
* Lead AI architecture inputs for proposals, RFP responses, and demonstrations, including solution narratives, prototypes, estimates, data requirements, and implementation assumptions.
* Communicate architecture decisions, evaluation results, residual risks, adoption readiness, and realized business impact clearly to executive and technical audiences.

**Reusable AI Solutions & Innovation**

* Develop reusable AI reference designs, evaluation suites, retrieval components, model integration patterns, and governance templates to accelerate consistent delivery.
* Assess emerging AI capabilities through structured experiments and business cases; scale only where evidence supports performance, operational feasibility, and acceptable risk.
* Enable finance-focused capabilities such as document intelligence, knowledge assistants, forecasting, and anomaly detection, with traceable outputs and controls appropriate to each use case.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of experience across software engineering, data platforms, solution architecture, or AI/ML, including substantial experience architecting and deploying production AI/ML solutions.
* 5+ years of technical people-management experience, with a proven track record of leading architects or engineering teams and delivering complex, cross-functional AI or data initiatives.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep experience designing AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including managed AI services, deployment options, security, resilience, and cost optimization.
* Strong foundations in machine learning, model evaluation, and applied statistics, with practical expertise in generative AI, LLMs, embeddings, vector search, RAG, and model adaptation trade-offs.
* Strong Python and software architecture skills, with experience in ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn), APIs, data pipelines, and enterprise application integration.
* Experience with MLOps and LLMOps, including experiment tracking, model registries, evaluation automation, CI/CD, model serving, observability, and lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of AI security and responsible AI, including data leakage, prompt injection, model limitations, explainability, fairness assessment, access controls, and human-in-the-loop design.

**AI Architecture & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to guide AI solutions from use-case discovery and feasibility assessment through architecture, evaluation, production deployment, and operational transition.
* Experience conducting architecture reviews, model and vendor evaluations, AI risk assessments, and production-readiness reviews across multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong skills in technical estimation, capacity planning, inference cost modeling, and total cost of ownership analysis, balancing model quality, latency, reliability, and business value.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Understanding of enterprise data and business processes; exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A) and associated control requirements is preferred.
* Experience applying AI/ML to finance transformation, ERP-connected workflows, document processing, forecasting, or enterprise analytics is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong people leadership, practice development, and coaching skills, with the ability to lead architects and influence data science, engineering, and business teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including executive-level engagement and the ability to explain AI capabilities, limitations, and risks without overstating results.
* Ability to balance AI strategy with pragmatic implementation, challenge assumptions using evidence, and make sound decisions amid rapidly evolving technology.
* High ownership mindset focused on responsible AI adoption, production reliability, solution quality, and measurable business outcomes.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Clients & Industries: Global C&I Strategic Operations Support**
**About EY**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. Join EY and help build a better working world. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Global Operations Support plays a key role in supporting operational excellence across the Clients & Industries (C&I) organization. This role focuses on enabling strategic priorities, optimizing processes, and facilitating collaboration across domains, functions, and pods to deliver agility and impact.
  
  
The C&I organization has six Domains, each with individual needs and differing maturity: Insights, Industry, Demand Generation, Client Excellence, Sales & Commercial Excellence, and Enablement & Technology.
  
  
This position sits within the Business Enablement – Business Management Office which supports the C&I organization through three key functions: Strategic Operations, Core Services, and Performance & Data Insights. Strategic Operations works through pods aligned to each of the six domains, working alongside Core Services and Performance & Data Insights to deliver seamless operational support and strategic execution.
  
  
Success in this model depends on agility — the ability to learn quickly, adapt as priorities change, and drive execution while staying responsive to evolving demands.
  
  
The primary stakeholder is the Domain Strategy Execution Leader, although this role will work with the rest of the Domain team. This position works directly with the Operations Senior Specialist or Operations Specialist.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Operations**

* Manage and execute domain initiatives and projects by working closely with senior stakeholders, applying strong project management discipline.
* Maintain project plans, timelines, documentation, and next steps, ensuring accuracy and timely updates.
* Drive project meetings, coordinate actions across contributors, advance activity as appropriate and track progress against milestones.
* Support preparation of leadership‑ready materials (presentations, updates, trackers), ensuring they meet EY standards and are ready for circulation.
* Identify project risks, dependencies, and opportunities to improve processes, escalating issues as appropriate.
* Act as a single point of coordination with relevant C&I domains and CBS Functions (e.g., BMC, Finance, Technology, AWS) to support delivery of project outcomes.

**Operational Excellence**

* Support consistent execution of operational processes by maintaining clear documentation, governance artifacts, and reporting.
* Proactively identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and enhance ways of working within the domain.
* Maintain and manage knowledge repositories, databases, SharePoint sites, and content libraries, including regular review and validation of materials.
* Share knowledge, insights, and updates with stakeholders using agreed communication channels.
* Support preparation of status reporting and dashboards, ensuring clarity in coordination with Performance & Data Insights where applicable.
* Assist the triage of requests for ad‑hoc analysis, reporting, and information, helping to embed new ways of working and reinforcing self‑service where possible.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Develop strong working relationships across domains, functions, and pods, anticipating needs and supporting broader team objectives.
* Manage stakeholder communications and expectations, providing clear, timely updates on progress, risks, and next steps.
* Act as a trusted delivery partner to leadership by ensuring follow‑through on actions and high‑quality execution.
* Participate actively in regular update calls and forums, contributing insights and supporting other team members as needed.
* Facilitate coordination across geographically dispersed teams to enable smooth execution and alignment.

**Skills & Attributes For Success**

* Good analytical and problem‑solving skills, with attention to detail.
* Experience supporting operational process design, improvement, and handoff.
* Competence in reporting, data visualization, and storyboarding, with the ability to translate data into clear insights.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders, delivering high‑quality outputs under tight timelines.
* A client‑focused mindset, with the ability to respond to changing needs and redirect effort as required.
* Clear, confident communicator with the ability to engage senior stakeholders effectively.
* Resilient, adaptable, and comfortable working in a global, matrixed environment with evolving priorities.
* Familiarity with AI/other automation to enhance processes, project outcomes and personal deliverables

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Client Experience Program Lead
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Discipline**
Client Experience
  
  
**Role Type**
CX Program Lead
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for CX Program Lead – Supervising Associate who can oversee Client Experience program within the Region. The focus is on embedding regular, robust client feedback that delivers insights that results in executed actions across the client life cycle to continually improve the experience for our clients. Build strong relationships with leadership and work with account teams to embed client experience into Account management activities. Equip our client serving teams with a continuous improvement mindset and the capability to conduct highly effective CXM (ASQ)/CXE (ESQ) and WLRs. Provide regular ‘voice of the client’ insight to leadership which will assist development of go-to market strategies, minimize the risk of client losses, and maximize revenue growth opportunities.

* Excellent in Project management

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* University/Master’s degree
* Approximately 8+ years plus of previous customer experience, program management, consulting or marketing experience
* Experience managing complex client relationships
* Worked in a large Global organization
* Proven ability to influence and build collaborative relationships with a wide range of stakeholders

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

The individual shall work with account teams to drive consistent adoption and activate accounts to establish and execute strategic client experience plans.

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Company Description**
CFA Master is a free-to-start CFA Level I study platform that provides candidates with an organized, curriculum-based dashboard. Learners gain access to notes, formula sheets, flashcards, practice questions, cheat sheets, mind maps, and a full mock exam to support comprehensive exam preparation. The resources are structured by module to help candidates track progress and focus on priority topics. CFA Master aims to make high-quality CFA exam preparation more accessible, efficient, and engaging for aspiring finance professionals.
  
**Role Description**
The Product Manager will oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of CFA Master’s learning platform, from ideation to launch and iteration. This full-time, on-site role based in Kochi involves defining product vision, prioritizing features, and maintaining the roadmap aligned with learner needs and business goals. Day-to-day responsibilities include gathering and analyzing user feedback and usage data, collaborating with content creators and designers, and working closely with engineering to deliver enhancements and new features on time. The Product Manager will refine user experience, optimize learning flows, and ensure study tools like notes, flashcards, and mock exams are cohesive and effective. The role also includes coordinating experiments, monitoring performance metrics, and communicating product updates to internal stakeholders.
  
**Qualifications**

* Product management skills, including roadmap ownership, requirements gathering, and feature prioritization.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with experience using data and user feedback to guide decisions.
* Familiarity with education technology, digital learning products, or test-prep platforms is highly beneficial.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams (content, design, engineering, marketing).
* Understanding of the CFA curriculum or prior CFA exam preparation experience is a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, economics, finance, or a related field; an advanced degree or relevant certification is an advantage.
* Comfort with agile or iterative product development methodologies.
* Ability to work on-site in Kochi and manage multiple initiatives with attention to detail and timelines.

title: Product Delivery Manager - ServiceNow - Moveworks
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Moveworks)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The Moveworks Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the Moveworks platform across the enterprise. The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Strong understanding of the Move works platform, including enterprise search, conversational AI, natural language understanding (NLU), employee support automation, and AI-driven workflow orchestration.
* Knowledge of Move works integration capabilities with ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, Slack, HR systems, identity platforms, and enterprise applications
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of ServiceNow applications (ITSM, ITOM, HRSD).

* Collaborate with technical, security and integration teams to configure, test, publish and monitor AI agents and agentic workflows within Oracle Fusion.
* Follow responsible AI controls covering role-based access, data privacy, traceability, testing, monitoring and business-owner approval.
* Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, cutover and production support, and drive timely resolution of defects and functional queries.
* Contribute to client presentations, solution demonstrations, estimates, proposals, knowledge assets and practice-development initiatives.
* Guide junior consultants, review assigned deliverables and maintain delivery quality and internal KPIs.

* Minimum 5 years of relevant Oracle SCM and Procurement experience, including strong hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud.
* At least two end-to-end ERP implementation or transformation engagements, including at least one Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM implementation.
* Strong functional expertise in Oracle Fusion Procurement—including Self Service Procurement, Purchasing, Sourcing, Supplier Qualification and Management, Supplier Portal and Procurement Contracts—together with hands-on knowledge of at least one core SCM area such as Inventory Management, Order Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain Planning, Product Management, Cost Management, Maintenance or Logistics.
* Hands-on experience with source-to-pay and procure-to-pay process design, enterprise structures, procurement business units, requisitioning, purchasing, approvals, catalogs, supplier onboarding, sourcing, contracts, receiving, integrations, data migration, reporting and operational controls.
* Practical knowledge of Oracle Redwood UX, including Redwood page adoption, process redesign, extension considerations, testing and end-user change management.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio, including agent configuration concepts, topics, instructions, tools, workflow orchestration, deployment, security and monitoring.
* Ability to support high-value agentic SCM use cases, such as supplier onboarding assistance, procurement policy guidance, order exception management, inventory insights or planning support.
* Client-facing delivery experience with sound planning, estimation, risk management, testing and quality assurance capabilities.
* Demonstrable industry/domain experience in at least one sector—such as retail, government, energy, real estate, oil and gas, manufacturing, utilities, logistics or consumer products—with practical understanding of sector-specific procurement, supplier, inventory, fulfilment, planning and operational-control requirements.

**Competencies / Skills:**

* Strong stakeholder management, consulting, collaboration and junior-team mentoring skills.
* Ability to independently manage assigned functional workstreams, priorities and deliverables within agreed timelines.
* Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills, with the ability to explain business and functional concepts clearly.
* Strong analytical, industry-process design, problem-solving and decision-making capabilities, with the ability to apply domain knowledge to Oracle Fusion SCM and Procurement solutions.
* Sound understanding of responsible AI, data privacy, access controls, human oversight and governance for enterprise agentic solutions.
* Awareness of Oracle quarterly updates and the ability to assess new SCM, Redwood and embedded-AI capabilities for business adoption.

title: Product Manager - Flex Platform
description:
**Job Title: Product Manager - Flex Platform**

**Location: Kochi or Bengaluru, India**

**Permanent - Full time**

**About Us**

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Product Manager to join the Flex Platform team, a cross-functional product organization responsible for building the shared platform capabilities, workflows, and services that power Cyncly's products globally.

You will own a defined product area end-to-end from understanding customer problems and shaping the product strategy through prioritization, delivery, launch, and measuring outcomes.

This role is ideal for a PM who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, working closely with customers and engineering teams, and turning complex business needs into simple, scalable product experiences. Areas may include business workflows, CRM, payments, integrations, data and analytics, platform services, AI-enabled capabilities, or other emerging platform opportunities.

**About the Team**

The Flex Platform team operates through small, autonomous, cross-functional pods, with each pod accountable for a defined product area and outcome.

As the PM for your pod, you will be the primary product decision-maker, working closely with engineering, design, QA, architecture, and business stakeholders.

We believe PMs should own outcomes rather than simply manage backlogs. You will have the autonomy to determine what problem to solve, why it matters, what to build, and how to measure whether it worked.

**Key Position Responsibilities include:**

**Product Discovery & Strategy**

* Understand customer, user, and business problems through research, data, and stakeholder insights.
* Define problems clearly before committing to solutions.
* Develop product hypotheses, evaluate alternatives, and make informed product trade-offs.
* Translate business strategy and customer needs into a clear product vision and roadmap for your area.
* Identify opportunities to create reusable platform capabilities that can scale across products, customers, and markets.

**Product Delivery**

* Own and prioritize the product backlog in partnership with engineering.
* Define product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
* Work closely with engineering, design, QA, and architecture throughout discovery and delivery.
* Make day-to-day product decisions and resolve ambiguity quickly.
* Balance customer needs, technical complexity, business value, and time-to-market.
* Ensure that products are delivered with the right level of quality, usability, and scalability.

**Customer & Stakeholder Management**

* Regularly engage with customers and users to validate problems and solutions.
* Partner with business unit leaders, customer success, sales, and other internal stakeholders.
* Build alignment across teams and communicate product decisions clearly.
* Represent the needs of your product area in quarterly planning and roadmap discussions.

**Outcomes & Continuous Improvement**

* Define measurable outcomes for the products and capabilities you own.
* Track adoption, usage, customer value, and business impact after launch.
* Use data and customer feedback to continuously improve the product.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, automate manual processes, and improve customer productivity.

**Cross-Platform Collaboration**

* Work across Flex Platform pods when your product area has dependencies on integrations, APIs, data, AI, payments, or other shared capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to leverage existing platform capabilities rather than building duplicate solutions.
* Help shape platform standards and reusable capabilities that benefit multiple Cyncly products.

**Go-to-Market & Communication**

* Partner with GTM, business units, and customer-facing teams to prepare products for launch.
* Communicate product changes, value propositions, and release plans clearly.
* Support customer and internal enablement for significant product launches.

**Required Experience and Qualifications:**

* 3 - 5 years of product management experience, preferably in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.
* Demonstrated experience owning a product area from discovery through delivery and measurable outcomes.
* Strong customer-first mindset and experience conducting customer or user discovery.
* Comfortable owning and prioritizing a backlog without relying on a dedicated Product Owner.
* Strong product judgment and ability to make trade-offs in ambiguous situations.
* Ability to translate complex business problems into simple, intuitive product experiences.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear product requirements, user stories, stakeholder communications, and product narratives.
* Comfortable working closely with engineering and understanding technical concepts, APIs, integrations, data, and platform architecture.
* Strong collaboration skills and the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Comfortable working across multiple products, business units, geographies, and time zones.
* Data-driven mindset with the ability to define and use product metrics to evaluate success.
* Ownership mentality, you take responsibility for outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience building platform products, shared services, or reusable capabilities.
* Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise applications, or vertical SaaS.
* Experience with APIs, integrations, data platforms, analytics, or workflow automation.
* Experience working with AI-enabled products or automation.
* Experience launching products across multiple markets or geographies.
* Experience working in an autonomous, cross-functional product pod or squad model.
* Experience with PLG, self-service products, or SaaS growth models.

**Working for Us**

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.

We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.

If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - Come join us.

title: Senior Manager, R&D (New Products)
description:
**Senior Manager, R&D (New Products)**
**About The Company**
Metantz connects the top 1% talents to global opportunities. This is an exciting opportunity with our award-winning customer, a deeptech ROV company, setting category benchmarks. They are a Kochi-based deep-tech company building underwater robots for places people can’t safely reach: dams, ports, ships and offshore infrastructure. Defence, government, infrastructure and energy customers in India and abroad already use our systems in the field. We are expanding our product portfolio, and we need a hands-on product leader to take the next generation of robots from idea to field-ready product.
  
  
**The role**
You will own the new product development pipeline and report to the CTO. This is not a pure research role, and it is not a sustaining-engineering role for existing products. You will turn emerging customer and mission needs into new, reliable, manufacturable robotic products. You will lead a multi-disciplinary team through concept, prototype, field trials and handover to production.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Define the new-product roadmap with the CTO and CEO, based on customer needs, market gaps and technology feasibility.
* Run new-product programs end to end: requirements, architecture, prototype, field trials, design freeze and production handover.
* Lead and mentor a multi-disciplinary team across mechanical, electronics, embedded, software, controls, sensors and communications.
* Run proof-of-concept and prototype cycles quickly, with clear go/no-go gates so that experiments don’t drift into commitments.
* Set up disciplined testing: lab, environmental, endurance and field trials. Feed every failure back into the design.
* Keep production handovers clean, with complete drawings, BOMs, firmware versions and test procedures.
* Work with Sales and customers on feasibility, estimates and early pilots for new products, and manage scope on custom requests.
* Manage program budgets, vendors, partners and component choices, including obsolescence and single-source risks.
* Contribute to IP creation and protection (patents, design records, documentation).
* Work closely with the existing product, production and field teams so that new products build on proven platforms.

**You might be a fit if you have**

* 8–12 years of experience in engineering and R&D, including 3+ years leading teams or programs.
* Experience at a robotics or drone company (UAV, UGV, marine or other autonomous systems), with new products taken from concept to field deployment.
* Hands-on depth in at least one core discipline (mechanical, electronics, embedded, controls or software) and enough breadth to lead across all of them.
* Experience with prototyping, validation, field trials and the move to manufacturing.
* Familiarity with sensors, navigation, communications and autonomy stacks (a strong plus).
* Exposure to defence, government or other high-reliability product requirements (a plus).
* A Bachelor’s or Master’s in electronics, electrical, mechanical, mechatronics, robotics, aerospace, computer science or a related field.
* Strong systems thinking, sound technical judgment and the discipline to deliver on commitments.

**What Success Looks Like In 180 Days**

* You have reviewed the current new-product pipeline, team capacity, technical risks and key-person dependencies.
* A prioritised new-product portfolio is agreed, with owners, milestones and go/no-go gates.
* At least one priority program has a validated architecture and a working prototype in test.
* A repeatable prototype-to-field-trial-to-handover process is in place.
* A regular review cadence surfaces risks early for the CTO and leadership.

**What This Role Is Not**
It isn’t research detached from delivery, a role where every design decision runs through you, a pure project coordination role without technical ownership, or a firefighting role for existing products.
  
  
**Why join**
You will build the next generation of robotics for some of the harshest environments on earth, work directly with the founders and CTO, and own new products from first sketch to the field.
  
  
**Location**
Kochi, Kerala. Full-time, with travel for trials, customers and partners.

title: Manager – Revenue (Kochi)
description:
**About The Team**
We are building a high-performance Revenue & Marketing pod — a geography-focused business unit that owns end-to-end top-line and bottom-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
  
  
This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data-fluent, and thrive in a fast-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Revenue & P&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth & Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end-to-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence & Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health & Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics & Reporting
* Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions

**Who We Are Looking For**
Must Have
  
  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution [IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e-commerce operations, or P&L-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

Good to Have
  
  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom
