title: Corporate Innovation Lab Leader
description:
At FedTec Reply, we are hiring an Innovation Lab leader to join our team. In this role you will be working on building innovative enablers and accelerators for our federal clients. Our ideal candidate is an inspiring technology leader who is a self-starter, always learning, proactive, and with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and lead the vision, roadmap, and delivery standards for FedTec's SaaS and AI-native innovation center, spanning AI transformation, service management, and cybersecurity offerings.
* Design, build, and maintain reusable enablers, accelerators, and reference architectures that reduce cost and time-to-value on federal client engagements.
* Recruit, mentor, and manage a multidisciplinary team of engineers, architects, and consultants, building a culture of innovation and continuous learning.
* Partner with business development and capture teams to shape technical solutions, proposals, and win strategies for federal opportunities.
* Cultivate strategic partnerships with cloud, SaaS, and AI technology vendors to bring emerging capabilities into FedTec's federal offerings.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to the firm’s technology leaders, translating mission needs into scalable, secure, AI-enabled solutions.

**Minimum Requirements (Mandatory)**

* 10+ years experience in technology consulting, solution architecture, or IT capability/practice leadership.
* 4 years experience building and leading multidisciplinary engineering or consulting teams.
* Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering SaaS-based or AI-native solutions for enterprise or government clients.
* Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity and compliance frameworks (e.g., NIST RMF, FedRAMP, Zero Trust).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field from a premier STEM institution.

**Preferred Qualifications (Good To Have)**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related technical field from a premier STEM institution.
* Experience with hyperscaler cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and modern DevSecOps practices.
* Familiarity with agentic AI, large language models, and AI/ML platform engineering.
* Industry certifications such as AWS or Azure Solutions Architect, ITIL, or CISSP.
* Track record of standing up new practice areas or capability centers from the ground up.

**About Reply**
Reply specializes in the design and implementation of solutions based on new communication channels and digital media. Reply is a network of highly specialized companies supporting global industrial groups operating in the telecom and media, industry and services, banking, insurance and public administration sectors in the definition and development of business models enabled for the new paradigms of AI, cloud computing, digital media and the Internet of Things. Reply services include Consulting, System Integration and Digital Services.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Corporate Innovation Lab Leader
description:
At FedTec Reply, we are hiring an Innovation Lab leader to join our team. In this role you will be working on building innovative enablers and accelerators for our federal clients. Our ideal candidate is an inspiring technology leader who is a self-starter, always learning, proactive, and with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and lead the vision, roadmap, and delivery standards for FedTec's SaaS and AI-native innovation center, spanning AI transformation, service management, and cybersecurity offerings.
* Design, build, and maintain reusable enablers, accelerators, and reference architectures that reduce cost and time-to-value on federal client engagements.
* Recruit, mentor, and manage a multidisciplinary team of engineers, architects, and consultants, building a culture of innovation and continuous learning.
* Partner with business development and capture teams to shape technical solutions, proposals, and win strategies for federal opportunities.
* Cultivate strategic partnerships with cloud, SaaS, and AI technology vendors to bring emerging capabilities into FedTec's federal offerings.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to the firm’s technology leaders, translating mission needs into scalable, secure, AI-enabled solutions.

**Minimum Requirements (Mandatory)**

* 10+ years experience in technology consulting, solution architecture, or IT capability/practice leadership.
* 4 years experience building and leading multidisciplinary engineering or consulting teams.
* Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering SaaS-based or AI-native solutions for enterprise or government clients.
* Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity and compliance frameworks (e.g., NIST RMF, FedRAMP, Zero Trust).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field from a premier STEM institution.

**Preferred Qualifications (Good To Have)**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related technical field from a premier STEM institution.
* Experience with hyperscaler cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and modern DevSecOps practices.
* Familiarity with agentic AI, large language models, and AI/ML platform engineering.
* Industry certifications such as AWS or Azure Solutions Architect, ITIL, or CISSP.
* Track record of standing up new practice areas or capability centers from the ground up.

**About Reply**
Reply specializes in the design and implementation of solutions based on new communication channels and digital media. Reply is a network of highly specialized companies supporting global industrial groups operating in the telecom and media, industry and services, banking, insurance and public administration sectors in the definition and development of business models enabled for the new paradigms of AI, cloud computing, digital media and the Internet of Things. Reply services include Consulting, System Integration and Digital Services.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Assistant Manager – Revenue (Kochi)
description:
**About The Team**
We are building a high-performance Revenue & Marketing pod — a geography-focused business unit that owns end-to-end top-line and bottom-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
  
  
This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data-fluent, and thrive in a fast-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Revenue & P&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth & Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end-to-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence & Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health & Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics & Reporting
* Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions

**Who We Are Looking For**
Must Have
  
  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution [IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e-commerce operations, or P&L-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

Good to Have
  
  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

title: Product Manager - CRM/ERP
description:
**Job Title: Product Manager - CRM/ERP**

**Location: Kochi or Bengaluru, India**

**Permanent - Full time**

**About Us**

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Product Manager to own and evolve Flex CRM, Cyncly's CRM and commercial workflow platform serving kitchen, bath, and flooring retailers across Europe and North America.

Flex CRM sits at the heart of the retailer's sales journey from capturing and managing leads through design, quoting, pricing, and ultimately converting opportunities into revenue.

This is a high-impact product role where you will work at the intersection of customer workflows, commercial software, and complex business operations. You will translate real customer problems and business needs into simple, scalable product experiences that help retailers sell more effectively.

You will own your product area end-to-end from customer discovery and product strategy through prioritization, delivery, launch, and measuring outcomes.

**About the Team**

The Flex Platform team operates through small, autonomous, cross-functional pods, with each pod accountable for a defined product area and outcome.

As the PM for the CRM pod, you will be the primary product decision-maker, working closely with engineering, design, QA, architecture, and business stakeholders.

You will have the autonomy to determine what problems to solve, why they matter, what to build, and how to measure whether it worked.

**Key Position Responsibilities include:**

**Product Strategy & Discovery**

* Own the Flex CRM product vision, strategy, roadmap, and outcomes.
* Develop a deep understanding of how retailers manage leads, customers, opportunities, designs, quotes, pricing, and payments.
* Regularly engage with customers, users, and customer-facing teams to identify problems and validate opportunities.
* Translate customer needs, business priorities, market trends, and product data into clear product opportunities.
* Define product hypotheses, evaluate alternatives, and make informed trade-offs.
* Identify opportunities to simplify complex retailer workflows and create scalable capabilities that can support multiple markets and customer segments.

**CRM & Commercial Workflows**

* Own and evolve key workflows across the retailer's customer and revenue journey, including:
* Lead and opportunity management
* Customer and project management
* Quote creation, versioning, and lifecycle
* Pricing, markup, discount, and commercial rules
* Design-to-quote workflows and integration with design applications
* Payment workflows
* Customer and consumer communication
* Notifications and follow-up workflows
* Enterprise and multi-location workflows
* You will not simply manage a feature backlog you will continuously look for ways to improve the end-to-end customer journey from lead to revenue.

**Platform & Cross-Product Collaboration**

* Work closely with other Flex Platform pods and product teams where CRM intersects with payments, catalog, design, consumer collaboration, integrations, data, and other platform capabilities.
* Define clear product boundaries, integration requirements, and data contracts in partnership with engineering and architecture.
* Identify opportunities to leverage shared platform capabilities rather than creating product-specific solutions.
* Help ensure CRM capabilities can scale across Cyncly products, markets, and customer segments.

**Global Product & Commercial Complexity**

* Shape product capabilities that work across European and North American markets, balancing global consistency with local requirements.
* Partner with engineering and relevant business stakeholders on complex areas such as taxation, VAT, pricing, and country-specific commercial requirements.
* Work with appropriate subject-matter experts to translate regulatory and business requirements into scalable product solutions.
* Balance local market needs with the long-term goal of maintaining a coherent global product.

**Product Delivery**

* Own and prioritize the CRM backlog in partnership with engineering.
* Define clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
* Work closely with engineering, design, QA, and architecture throughout discovery and delivery.
* Make product decisions quickly and resolve ambiguity without unnecessary escalation.
* Balance customer value, business impact, technical complexity, scalability, and time-to-market.
* Ensure successful launches and adoption of new capabilities.

**Outcomes & Continuous Improvement**

* Define and track meaningful product outcomes and success metrics.
* Monitor adoption, workflow completion, quote conversion, customer engagement, and other relevant product signals.
* Use product data and customer feedback to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Identify opportunities for automation and AI to reduce manual work and improve retailer productivity.
* Turn customer and usage insights into future roadmap priorities.

**Go-to-Market & Stakeholder Leadership**

* Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and business unit leaders on product positioning, launches, and customer adoption.
* Communicate product strategy, roadmap decisions, and releases clearly across R&D and GTM.
* Support enterprise customers and strategic implementations where product input is required.
* Build alignment across stakeholders and influence decisions without direct authority.

**Required Experience and Qualifications:**

* 4-7 years of product management experience, preferably in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, retail technology, commerce, or another workflow-intensive domain.
* Demonstrated experience owning a product area from discovery through delivery and measurable outcomes.
* Strong customer-first instinct, you regularly engage with users and use customer insight to shape product decisions.
* Strong commercial understanding and an ability to connect product decisions to customer value and business outcomes.
* Experience working with complex workflows, configurable business rules, pricing, or other domain-heavy product areas.
* Strong product judgment and the ability to make pragmatic trade-offs in ambiguous situations.
* Ability to write clear, concise product requirements and communicate effectively with engineering, design, business, and executive stakeholders.
* Comfortable working closely with engineering and understanding technical concepts such as APIs, integrations, data models, and system boundaries.
* Strong collaboration and influencing skills, particularly across teams and geographies.
* Data-driven mindset with the ability to define and use product metrics to evaluate success.
* Ownership mentality you take responsibility for outcomes, not just delivery.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience building CRM, CPQ, quoting, payments, commerce, ERP, or retail software.
* Experience working with retailers, manufacturers, or other multi-location businesses.
* Experience working across European and North American markets.
* Experience building platform capabilities or products used across multiple markets or business units.
* Experience with APIs, integrations, workflow automation, analytics, or AI-enabled products.
* Experience working in an autonomous, cross-functional product pod or squad model.

**Working for Us**

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.

We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.

If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - Come join us.

title: RC FS-BT INS-P And C-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.

**The Opportunity**

title: Microservices Architect
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced Microservices Architect to perform the role of Engineering Manager, leading the architecture, design, planning, and delivery of large-scale eCommerce initiatives built on a Java-based microservices ecosystem. This role combines engineering leadership, solution architecture, and delivery ownership to ensure successful execution of strategic platform modernization and customer experience initiatives.
  
  
This is a technology-first, hands-on engineering leadership role. The successful candidate must remain actively involved in architecture, technical decision-making, engineering quality, and solution delivery while leading distributed engineering teams.
  
  
**Core Requirements**

* 15+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years in engineering leadership, architecture, or delivery leadership roles.
* Design distributed data architectures and determine appropriate database strategies across relational, NoSQL, cache, search, and event-streaming platforms.
* Familiar with observability platforms like Jaeger, Prometheus, Grafana.
* Define microservices architecture, service boundaries, bounded contexts, and domain decomposition using DDD principles.
* Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio or equivalent.
* Strong hands-on engineering background in Java and Spring Boot microservices, with the ability to review architecture, designs, APIs, and implementation approaches.
* Experience designing and delivering large-scale eCommerce or digital-commerce platforms.
* Deep understanding of REST APIs, distributed systems, integration patterns, event-driven architecture, and messaging or streaming technologies such as Kafka.
* Strong knowledge of cloud-native architecture and public cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, DevOps, observability, SRE practices, resiliency, and production operations.
* Strong understanding of database technologies, caching strategies, scalability, performance optimization, security, and high-volume platform readiness.
* Lead technical design reviews and guide teams on scalable, secure, maintainable, resilient, and high-performing solution designs.
* Collaborate closely with SRE and platform engineering teams to drive observability, reliability, performance optimization, capacity planning, and operational excellence.
* Define and enforce engineering standards, architecture principles, development practices, and technical governance.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence through continuous improvement, innovation, automation, code quality, technical debt reduction, and adoption of modern engineering practices.
* Mentor engineering leads and senior engineers on architecture, design thinking, engineering best practices, problem solving, and technical decision-making while supporting their professional growth.
* Champion engineering quality through code reviews, testing strategies, CI/CD practices, release governance, and production readiness assessments.
* Working knowledge of AI and GenAI concepts and their practical application in software development, engineering productivity, personalization, recommendation systems, and customer experience initiatives.
* Act as the primary technical and delivery leader for customer and internal stakeholders, driving technical discussions, resolving escalations, influencing solution decisions, and building stakeholder confidence.
* Strong stakeholder communication, project planning, risk management, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
* Proven experience leading distributed engineering teams, including offshore teams, and owning complex delivery from estimation through deployment and production stabilization.
* Coordinate execution across cross-functional teams, product & platform teams, and external vendors or partners involved in the client engagement.

title: Director - Entertainment PRS, Malayalam
description:

The incumbent will act as a key link between Programming/Content team and Sales teams and drive the brand philosophy and sales/revenue strategy for the channel to optimize channel inventory. * Key Responsibilities

* organization objectives, budget for the year, market scenario, competition, etc. in order to ensure the sales organization achieves overall revenue target.

* Building bottom-up revenue plans for the fiscal, quarter & month

Product Understanding

* Creating & implementing trade marketing agenda for the channel – Mailers, On Air promos, Trade events etc.
* Define a measurement process to ensure that client and agency are aligned on key performance metrics, establishing realistic business goals, and providing frontline support through reporting and analytics
* Impact landscape sizing of a particular genre – understand the kind of impact properties across channels, changes and evolutions compared to the previous year and deeper understanding of the advertisers who buy impact

**Cross functional collaboration:**

* Engage with sales teams for ensuring revenue rationalization by forecasting projections/trends for a healthy business and designing attractive packages for the sales team to take to the market, conducting roadshows.
* Prepare the sales team so they can handle queries from clients and media planners/buyers with confidence.
* Supporting ad sales team with operational tasks on rate cards, internal deal approvals, client sales proposals etc.

title: General Manager, BibleOn
description:
General Manager, BibleOn

**Location:**
Kochi, Kerala

**Employment:**
Full-time, on-site

**Reporting to:**
Thomson Philip, Co-founder of BibleOn and CEO of Eloit Innovations

**About BibleOn**

BibleOn is a free, ad-free Bible app with a mission to bring the Word of God to people in their own language. Rooted in the Catholic faith and welcoming everyone, BibleOn offers text and audio Scriptures in international, regional and tribal languages, helping individuals and families build a deeper relationship with Jesus through His Word.

Our vision extends beyond an app. We are building a global community of readers, listeners, volunteers, supporters and digital missionaries who help others discover and engage with the Holy Scriptures.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an exceptional, mission-driven leader to take full responsibility for leading BibleOn into its next stage of growth.

The General Manager, BibleOn will assume day-to-day leadership from the Co-founder and lead the initiative with independence, sound judgement and accountability. Working within the vision, strategic direction and agreed budgets set with the Co-founder, you will translate that vision into clear priorities, build the right team and deliver measurable results.

This role combines ministry leadership with the discipline of running a growing digital platform. You will lead operations, product priorities, language expansion, content, audience growth, Church partnerships, fundraising and campaigns, working with the existing team and recruiting additional talent as required.

We are looking for someone who can take ownership, make decisions and move the mission forward with limited day-to-day supervision.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Lead the Mission and Strategy**

* Translate BibleOn’s vision into an actionable growth plan with clear milestones, budgets and measures of success.
* Take ownership of execution across the entire initiative, resolving challenges and keeping priorities focused.
* Work closely with the Co-founder on strategic direction, major partnerships and decisions requiring his guidance.
* Provide concise, regular updates on progress, finances, opportunities and matters requiring leadership attention.

**2. Lead Operations and Build the Team**

* Assume responsibility for daily operations and coordinate the existing team across technology, content, languages, outreach and user support.
* Recruit, develop and lead employees, volunteers, language coordinators and external collaborators.
* Establish clear responsibilities, practical workflows and a culture of service, accountability and follow-through.
* Manage budgets, resources and delivery schedules to support sustainable growth.

**3. Expand Languages and Content**

* Develop and execute a plan to expand BibleOn’s text and audio Bible offerings, particularly for underserved language communities.
* Build relationships with Bible publishers, rights holders, translators, recording partners and Church organisations.
* Oversee permissions, content sourcing, production, quality review and publication.
* Develop Scripture-centred content and initiatives that encourage regular Bible reading, listening and spiritual growth.
* Maintain fidelity to Catholic teaching in BibleOn’s original faith content, supported by appropriate theological review.

**4. Grow the Audience and Community**

* Lead user acquisition, engagement and retention across countries and language communities.
* Plan and deliver digital campaigns, parish outreach, community programmes and partnerships.
* Build a network of digital missionaries, volunteers and ambassadors who introduce BibleOn to others.
* Use audience insights and performance data to improve campaigns, content and the user experience.

**5. Build Global Church Relationships**

* Develop active partnerships with dioceses, parishes, religious congregations, Catholic institutions, ministries and lay movements.
* Draw on an established global Catholic network to create opportunities for distribution, language expansion, collaboration and support.
* Represent BibleOn professionally at Church gatherings, conferences and partner meetings.
* Build lasting relationships grounded in trust, service and a shared commitment to spreading the Word of God.

**6. Lead Fundraising and Campaigns**

* Develop and execute a fundraising strategy that supports BibleOn’s free, ad-free mission.
* Build relationships with individual donors, Catholic foundations, institutions and other mission-aligned supporters.
* Lead donation campaigns, sponsorship proposals and supporter communications.
* Establish responsible donor stewardship, with clear reporting on the use of funds and the impact achieved.
* Work with finance and professional advisers on donation processes, financial controls and applicable requirements.

**7. Guide Product Development and User Experience**

* Work with the technology team to prioritise improvements based on mission needs, user feedback and growth opportunities.
* Coordinate product releases, content launches and campaigns.
* Champion accessibility, reliability and ease of use across languages and user groups.
* Monitor adoption, engagement, user support and product performance, turning findings into practical improvements.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* **A practising Catholic**
  , with a personal commitment to prayer, Scripture, the sacramental life and the mission of the Church.
* **An established and active global network within the Catholic Church**
  , with the ability to build trusted relationships across clergy, religious communities, institutions, ministries and lay leaders.
* Proven experience leading an organisation, ministry, business unit or substantial initiative, with responsibility for people, budgets, execution and results.
* The ability to function independently, exercise sound judgement and take full ownership while remaining accountable to the Co-founder’s vision and guidance.
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills, including the ability to present BibleOn’s mission convincingly to partners, donors and communities.
* Willingness to work full-time from Kochi and travel within India and internationally when required.

Experience and Capabilities We Value

* Leadership experience in digital products, technology, Catholic ministry, publishing, media, fundraising or the social impact sector.
* A demonstrated record of growing audiences, communities, partnerships or donor support.
* Experience recruiting and leading multidisciplinary teams, including volunteers and external partners.
* Confidence with budgets, performance metrics, digital campaigns and project delivery.
* Experience working across languages, cultures and international networks.
* A relevant degree or equivalent professional experience. An MBA or postgraduate qualification is an advantage.

**What Success Looks Like**

* BibleOn operates effectively under your leadership, with the Co-founder able to focus on strategic guidance.
* The team has clear priorities, defined responsibilities and consistent delivery.
* More people discover BibleOn, return regularly and engage deeply with Scripture.
* New language communities gain access to quality text and audio Bible content.
* Church partnerships generate active collaboration and measurable reach.
* Donations and supporter relationships provide a stronger foundation for the mission.
* BibleOn grows while remaining faithful to its Catholic identity and free, ad-free purpose.

**Who Will Thrive in This Role**

You combine a heart for evangelisation with the ability to build and lead. You are comfortable developing strategy, meeting a bishop, presenting to a donor, guiding a team and following through on practical details.

* You see bringing the Word of God to more people as a personal calling, and you have the leadership ability to turn that commitment into sustained action.

title: Staff Architect
description:
We are looking for a Staff Architect to help drive architecture across two connected pillars at organisation: the internal AI engineering platform that accelerates how teams build, and the client-facing product architecture that our customers depend on every day. This is a hands-on, deeply collaborative technical leadership role for someone who has shipped real systems with LLMs and agents, who is comfortable shaping architecture across services, data, security and developer experience, and who is energized by working through other engineers rather than around them.

**The Role**

You will help drive the technical direction of organisation's AI engineering platform and the architecture of our client-facing products. That means partnering with engineering leads, product, security and operations to shape the systems that internal teams build on, the products customers rely on and the AI capabilities that increasingly run through both. You will write code, write design docs, lead reviews, mentor other senior and staff engineers and turn good local decisions into durable enterprise patterns.

This role is intentionally cross-cutting. You will move between platform problems (how engineers and product managers ship faster and more consistently across the company) and product problems (how our client-facing systems scale, integrate, stay secure and incorporate AI in ways that hold up in a regulated industry).

**Key Responsibilities**

**Internal AI Engineering Platform**

* Help drive the architecture of organisation's internal AI scaffolding platform, including agent orchestration, skill and contract design, multi-IDE adapters (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and successors) and the developer experience that ties them together.
* Co-design enterprise-wide standards for building with LLMs and agents: prompt and context patterns, retrieval and grounding, tool integration, evals, guardrails, cost and latency budgets, observability and incident response.
* Partner with engineering leads across product teams to evolve their stacks toward shared scaffolding rather than parallel reinvention, and contribute reusable skills, templates and adapters back to the platform.
* Help shape the evaluation strategy for AI features: how we measure quality, regressions, safety and business impact, and how evals are wired into CI, staging and production telemetry.
* Influence model selection, agent framework choices, vendor versus in-house tradeoffs and where to place the boundaries between platform and product code.

**Client-Facing Product Architecture**

* Partner with product engineering leads to drive the architecture of organisation's client-facing systems across the surfaces customers interact with, including web applications, APIs, integrations and embedded AI features.
* Shape the service architecture: domain boundaries, service decomposition, design platform services, AI services and event-driven patterns.
* Contribute to the data architecture in close collaboration with the Data Architect: how transactional, analytical and regulatory data flows through products, how contracts are defined between systems, how lineage and quality are preserved.
* Help drive the AI in product strategy: where LLMs, RAG, agents and assistive features belong in customer-facing workflows, how they are evaluated, how they fail gracefully and how their behavior is auditable.
* Shape choices around scalability, performance, multi-tenancy and resilience for client workloads, including capacity planning, caching, rate limiting, async processing and graceful degradation.
* Co-design the security and compliance posture for products in a regulated domain: authentication, authorization, tenancy isolation, encryption, secrets handling, audit logging and data residency.
* Influence observability and operability standards: telemetry, logging, tracing, SLOs, on-call ergonomics and incident review.
* Guide integration and interoperability decisions across customer integrations, third-party services, data feeds and partner platforms.

**Technical Leadership Across Both Pillars**

* Lead and contribute to design reviews, architecture decision records and technical writing that sets the bar for the broader engineering organization.
* Mentor staff and senior engineers across teams. Coach them through hard tradeoffs rather than making the calls for them.
* Be the technical voice that helps leadership decide what to build, what to buy and what to retire, and that translates technical reality back to business stakeholders.
* Work with security, compliance and risk to make sure AI-driven workflows and product features meet ORAGANISATION's obligations around data handling, auditability, access control and regulatory exposure.
* Stay close to the broader industry. Bring back practices that are working elsewhere and adapt them to our context.

**Essential Criteria**

* 11+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a clear track record of technical leadership at staff level or equivalent cross-team scope.
* Demonstrated experience designing and shipping production systems built on LLMs or autonomous agents. You can speak in detail to systems you architected, the tradeoffs you made and what you would do differently.
* Strong distributed systems and software architecture background. You can move fluently between service design, API design, data flow, security and developer experience.
* Hands-on experience architecting client-facing SaaS or enterprise products: service boundaries, APIs, integrations, multi-tenancy, performance, resilience and observability.
* Working understanding of data architecture: storage choices (relational, document, analytical, vector), data contracts and how product systems and data platforms meet at the boundary.
* Hands-on fluency with modern AI engineering practice: prompt and context engineering, retrieval augmented generation, agent orchestration, tool use, evals and guardrails.
* Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives through influence in a mid to large engineering organization. You can move a group of senior engineers toward shared decisions without relying on positional authority.
* Strong written and verbal communication. You can write a one-page design doc that aligns a room of senior people and a five-line summary that aligns an executive.
* A pragmatic, collaborative mindset. You balance rigor with delivery, work inside legacy constraints and still move the architecture forward.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience building developer tooling or internal platforms at enterprise scale, especially scaffolding, code generation, workflow automation or developer productivity systems.
* **Experience integrating AI assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot or similar) into team workflows as a deliberate engineering practice, not just individual use**
  .
* Familiarity with MCP-style tool integration, agent contracts and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
* Experience with eval frameworks (LangSmith or commercial/in-house equivalents) and with observability for LLM and agent systems in production.
* Experience designing for compliance, audit and regulatory requirements in financial services, healthcare or another regulated, data-sensitive domain.
* **Familiarity with cloud-native architecture on AWS (or equivalent), containerization, IaC and modern CI/CD.**
* A track record of writing or speaking publicly about software architecture or AI engineering practice.

**What We Offer**

* A senior technical leadership role with scope across both the AI platform that internal teams build on and the products our customers rely on.
* The chance to help define the architectural standards and patterns that hundreds of engineers and product managers will use every day.
* A collaborative, forward-thinking team that takes both engineering rigor and emerging AI practice seriously.
* The opportunity to work at the intersection of regulated financial data and modern AI tooling, where the technical bar and the business stakes are both high.

**Strategy Consultant**
**THE OPPORTUNITY:**
EY's Technology Strategy & Transformation (TST) team is at the forefront of delivering cutting-edge consulting and advisory services to some of the largest enterprises across the globe. Our technology practice is recognized by industry analysts as a leader in leveraging business and technology to drive strategic business-led, tech-enabled e2e transformation. We serve clients across all major industries and work with organizations of different sizes, helping guide them to achieve business success while delivering strategic IT value.
  
  
**Scope of engagements**
We are currently seeking experienced, seasoned IT Strategy practitioners who can be positioned at the crucial intersection of business, technology and customer to devise creative new strategies based on trends, insights and data. We are looking for folks who have experience in advising clients to …
  
  

* reset, reimagine and re-think their business and operating models with tech-enabled, cutting-edge solutions that re-energize performance across the enterprise
* set and drive enterprise tech vision and strategy in alignment with corporate / business unit strategy, customer focus and solution teams
* drive increased value from technology spend with focus on optimizing cost, agility, productivity and performance

We work with clients to address issues of importance to the Chief Information Officer (CIO) and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) in creating value and delivering world-class IT capabilities to support futuristic business needs. Working closely with our industry groups and leveraging the Ernst & Young brand as independent, trusted advisors, we provide our high-profile clients with range of services including:
  
  

* Tech Strategy & Vision
* IT Operating Model optimization
* 3/5-year Transformation strategy, roadmaps & blueprints
* Office of CIO functions (IT Finance, Sourcing, Project Portfolio Mgt. etc)
* Product strategy & management
* M&A due-diligence, planning and post integration/separation
* Enterprise Architecture Services

**Key responsibilities of candidate include:**

* Understanding the business strategy & vision and translating them into enterprise-wide technology vision & strategy in alignment with strategic priorities for growth, customer experience, efficiency etc.
* Analyze value chain and business capabilities to develop clear understanding of strategic objectives, KPI’s, processes and underlying systems that deliver the business outcomes
* Assess the impact of the business strategy on business capability model and business processes to identify optimization opportunities (through tech-enabled solutions) across organization, systems, data, infrastructure and applications
* Have strong experience in analysing business models, business model innovation/ incubation, and experience in one or more of the following areas preferred: Market Strategy, Pricing/ Monetization, Finance, Ecosystem Management, and/ or Product Management
* Ability to analyse client’s (IT) Operating Model including the organization structure, processes and governance while developing recommendations and/or creating actionable roadmaps
* Significant experience in: 1) developing business capability model for the enterprise; 2) analysing enterprise-wide portfolio of systems / platforms and 3) function as guardian of the transformation strategy and business architecture to make sure that new initiatives comply with strategic priorities
* Solid experience in guiding our clients through large, enterprise-wide transformation to implement their strategies and business architecture. Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the IT strategic and improvement agenda
* Be a trusted advisor on 'innovation' with ability to frame key business and technology trends within the context of the client's objectives. Ability to identify the potential implications and impacts of the associated trends.
* Leverage EY’s global network, and leverage the cross-functional expertise to develop relevant architecture insights

**Within the team, your role will include the following additional responsibilities:**

* Ability to lead conversations with the client stakeholders. Strong communication skills as the profile requires interactions with CIO, CEO, CFO and other senior leadership
* Build and develop trusted relationships as a strategic technology advisor with clients and work internally across EY advisory teams to bring our clients the most comprehensive, end-to-end services and effectively address their business challenges.
* Building and growing TST Strategy practice, developing and maintaining client relationships, and selling and delivering work as an engagement leader or Subject Matter Specialist.
* Develop thought leadership and define approaches to provide structured solutions to complex technology strategy problems of clients, by recombining existing methodologies and teams
* Managing engagement teams and providing leadership in the assessment, design, and management of successful Business - IT transformation engagements in collaboration with our clients. They should provide high quality client services by directing daily progress of engagement work, informing EY leadership of engagement status, and managing staff performance
* Help recruit, develop and retain strategy professionals, coach and mentor team members, deliver architecture-related training and take on other practice management tasks as needed (e.g., development of practice offerings)
* Should be very good at using various tools (Such as Word, Excel, Powerpoint, visualization tools, MS-Project, etc.)
* Would support in developing new solution offerings, tools and knowledge repositories
* People skill has worked independently on projects or as part of small consulting teams
* Should be self-driven and organized person with ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high pressure environment
* Should have experience in pursuit teams including conceptualizing propositions and presenting solutions to client
* Create expert content for point-of-view and use advanced presentation, public speaking, content creation and communication skills for C-Level discussions.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of a specific industry, client or technology and function as an expert to advise senior leadership.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Strong academic background with BE/B.tech and MBA from top Tier-1 B-schools
* A background in Strategy Consulting (in top tier consulting firms), with 5+ years of relevant experience in large-scale, enterprise-wide transformations
* Min. of 5+ years of specific industry / sector experience through completed client engagements related to business transformation. Should have experience in any one or two industry sectors such as Financial services, Retail, Healthcare/Pharma, Telecom, e-commerce, etc.
* Demonstrated experience of driving business workshops as well as conducting deep-dive technology workshops to collaboratively develop transformation vision, strategy, roadmaps and blueprints
* Experience with assessing maturity of IT operating models & organizations structure to determine optimization opportunities. Should understand IT - business alignment, IT strategy and planning, development of current and future state IT architecture, roadmaps, IT/Digital maturity assessment, etc.
* Experience with large transformation related to customer experience, process re-engineering, digital, cloud, automation, AI/ML/advanced analytics, next-gen / emerging tech (IoT, blockchain, virtual twins etc).
* Conducting research and analyses of operational effectiveness, processes, stakeholders, etc., creating end-to-end visibility into how the organization executes their operations today and identifying systemic issues impacting business performance
* Should have experience in designing and managing an effective IT governance framework across the spectrum of IT service delivery
* Should be able to analyze data and translate findings into meaningful insights, integrating relevant business knowledge
* Should have knowledge about or exposure to areas such as IT Service Management and Governance, Agile methodologies, Data visualization, Cloud technologies, emerging technologies

**The following are preferred, but not required:**

* Advanced business and/or technology degrees from tier-1 schools (MBA, Masters)
* Experience in presenting directly to the C-Suite and explain complex concepts to anyone from an intern to a CFO, CHRO or CMO
* Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the strategic and improvement agenda.
* Speaking at industry conferences, round tables, and other public forums
* Authoring articles and white papers
* Business / technology innovation experience with emerging tech solutions leveraging power of combinatorial technologies AI/ML, Data Automation, Blockchain, IoT, etc
* Exposure across key technology domains is preferred (application, data, DevOps, infrastructure, cloud, network. security etc)
* Demonstrated capability to drive sales and bring a network of client relationships to the firm
* Relevant industry certification (e.g., TOGAF Biz Architect, Business Process Framework (eTOM Practitioner of TMForum), AWS Cloud Certified etc.).

**Overall Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Understanding of the current IT environment and industry IT trends to identify the engagement and client service issues.
* Ability to act as day-to-day client contact on the project engagement; run client status and other client meetings and deliver executive-level presentations that drive actions and decisions.
* Proven delivery skills including the ability to scope/size a project; staff a team with the appropriate skill set; provide subject matter direction and guidance to a team; and manage the delivery of an engagement.
* Ability to identify opportunities and help generate sell-on work during client engagements by understanding a range services and offerings and coordinating with personnel in other service lines to help sell integrated solutions that meet client needs.
* Experience in creating points of view on relevant industry trends, solutions, methodologies, and analytical frameworks and tools to bring strategic perspectives to existing solutions.
* Experience in managing a portfolio of executive level clients and developing long-term trusted advisor relationships.
* Experience in building strong teams with a solid understanding of project management, industry content knowledge, and effective client communications.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM, work is more than a job - it's a calling: To build. To design. To code. To consult. To think along with clients and sell. To make markets. To invent. To collaborate. Not just to do something better, but to attempt things you've never thought possible. Are you ready to lead in this new era of technology and solve some of the world's most challenging problems? If so, let’s talk. You will join a dynamic Product Management group at IBM Software. You will gain significant experience, getting opportunities in performing a variety of roles in both Inbound and Outbound Product Management
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**

* As a Product Manager, you will own outcomes. This will include:
* Working closely with customers and other market experts to define capabilities that are needed for their success and support our business strategy.
* Work closely with peer product managers in defining and driving product/business strategy for the IBM Software products portfolio to achieve business revenue targets and increase market share in a growing market.
* Work closely with Design to concept delightful user experiences using narratives and well-baked requirements.
* Work closely with Development to document requirements, groom the backlog, forecast releases, plan iterations, and deliver high quality product to end users.
* Develop effective demos for sellers and sales engineers (e.g., client technical professionals)
* Collaborate with CTPs, sellers, CSMs, Expert Labs, technology partners and business partners.
* Ideal candidates for this role are individuals who flourish in a high-performance environment and cultivate the same from peers and respective teams. In addition, they are:
* Relentlessly passionate about product design, user experience, and implementing features with minimal complexity.
* Skilled at breaking down high level initiatives into actionable work items which can be delivered through Product Development Life Cycle.
* Skilled at work prioritization and backlog management
* Stewards of process and practices but not to the point of conformity where it can impact business value and team productivity.

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related fields.
* Pursuing MBA course from reputed Business School.
* Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to influence people and establish relationships / build rapport with technical and non-technical stakeholders

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* 6 months to 1 Year exposure to one or more industry leading enterprise agile planning or development tools such as IBM Engineering Workflow Management (formally known as Rational Team Concert), Microsoft's Github/GitLab, Aha! Portfolio Management, Atlassian's Jira, etc.
* 1 to 2 years of Technology Industry Experience
* 1 to 2 years of experience as a business analyst or product manager in any industry/domain.
* Understanding of product roadmaps, end-to-end lifecycles, release cadence, and support.
* Experience in customer-driven usability and hypothesis-driven experimentation.
* A deep passion for innovation and creating data-backed solutions.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
description:

**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

: GDS ES Growth & Innovation

Provide NVIDIA alliance leadership with timely business insights through structured reporting, dashboards and executive-ready narratives covering sales, pipeline, opportunity tagging, partner-sourced and co-sell activity, prospect tracking, key GTM wins, book of business movements, partner program measures and other performance indicators. Manage stakeholder expectations, communication plans and delivery commitments with clarity, responsiveness and strong service orientation across global and regional teams.

* Working knowledge of sales, revenue, pipeline, opportunity lifecycle, partner program metrics, GTM motions, co-sell or referral activity, partner distinctions, specialization requirements and performance reporting, with the ability to interpret data and convert it into concise executive-ready insights.
* Strong program and project management skills, including planning, tracking, governance cadence management, risk and dependency monitoring, action follow-up and management of multiple priorities with competing deadlines.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with Power BI, Power Automate, SharePoint, workflow tools or other reporting and collaboration platforms considered an advantage.
* Experience with continuous improvement, process simplification and operational excellence, including process mapping, SOP development, control documentation, audit readiness, root cause analysis and issue resolution.
* Ability to identify automation opportunities and apply digital tools responsibly to improve productivity, reporting quality, follow-up discipline, knowledge management and stakeholder experience.
* Practical exposure to generative AI tools for research, content development, summarization, insight generation, workflow support and productivity enhancement; preferable exposure to Agentic AI concepts,
* AI-enabled process automation, AI agents or Copilot-style productivity tools.
* Strong stakeholder management capability, with the ability to engage senior onshore stakeholders, anticipate needs, manage expectations and build trusted advisor relationships across functions and geographies.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including business writing, executive presentation development, narrative building and the ability to create high-quality content with limited initial guidance.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem solving, research capability and attention to detail, with the ability to work across multiple teams to drive practical and timely resolution.
* Experience working in virtual, matrixed and multi-geography environments with cultural sensitivity, collaboration discipline and a global mindset.
* Knowledge of EY and GDS operations, organization structure, operating model, management information systems and independence concepts for internal candidates; Big 4, consulting, technology or leadership support exposure for external candidates would be preferred.

**Job Requirements:**
**Academics:**

* MBA, postgraduate qualification, or equivalent professional experience preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree required; degree in business, technology, engineering, commerce, or a related discipline preferred.
* Project/program management certification, process improvement certification, or relevant alliance, partner program, NVIDIA, technology partner or enterprise software certification would be an added advantage.
* Relevant certifications or digital badges in generative AI, responsible AI, AI-enabled productivity, prompt engineering, automation, analytics, or Agentic AI concepts would be highly desirable, particularly where they demonstrate practical application in business operations, reporting, process improvement, knowledge management, or stakeholder enablement.

**Experience:**

* 8+ years of progressive, relevant experience in alliance operations, program management, business operations, sales/GTM enablement, ecosystem support, consulting operations, technology partner enablement or enterprise technology partner operations; exposure to NVIDIA or comparable technology alliance environments would be preferred.
* Demonstrated experience supporting senior stakeholders in a matrixed, global environment, with exposure to governance routines, executive reporting, process coordination, and cross-functional delivery.
